measurement.scope: native compiler frontend plus process startup and IR output; warm page cache
measurement.memory_note: Original wait4 peak RSS includes inherited parent pre-exec RSS; small-job values hit a 144812 KiB floor. Use the separately metered GNU time memory observations, not these small-job RSS values.

corpus_audit.scope: ordinary versus PGO native compiler emitted IR, diagnostics, and exit status parity; existing acceptance/rejection unchanged
corpus_audit.home_policy: Both variants read the identical explicitly fixed source/runtime/library tree; only their compiler machine-code optimization differs.

limitations: Frontend timings; not full AOT build or generated program throughput
Raw wait4 small-job RSS has an inherited harness floor; use separate GNU time observations

memory_follow_up.method: GNU time child peak RSS, separate from timed cohort
memory_follow_up.limitation: One separately metered observation per variant and workload; not a repeated memory benchmark.
